description: Transform your time-based data analysis with the most advanced time intelligence visual for Power BI. Key Features Interactive Time Intelligence Dynamic Period Selection: Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly, YTD Smart Comparisons: Previous Period or Same Period Last Year Intelligent Filtering: Year, Quarter, and Month filters that adapt to your selection Positional Comparison: Accurately compares sub-periods (e.g., Week 1 vs Week 1) Powerful Visualizations Dual Chart Types: Column or Bar chart orientation 3 Comparison Styles: Side by Side, Overlapped, or Behind (Ghost) Trend Analysis: Built-in trend line with customizable styling Moving Average: Configurable period moving average overlay Error Bars: Visual % change indicators with 4 different styles Smart Period Summary Replaces traditional titles with intelligent narratives showing: Highest and lowest periods Total and average values Overall % change vs comparison period 3 narrative styles: Full, Compact, or Minimal Advanced Calculations Year to Date (YTD), Month to Date (MTD), Quarter to Date (QTD) Running Totals (recalculated after filtering) Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) Sequential and positional period comparisons Rich Customization (40+ Options) Data Labels: 4 position options with background and formatting Axes: Full control over titles, labels, grid lines, ranges Bar Styling: Gradients, patterns, shadows,…
